Player Impressions:
Hoyos - He's come up big a couple of times, including the Messi free kick.  He was beaten on the goal, when Fray should have been marked.
Jacob - has been getting up the pitch, but less so than his normal.  He's taking a bit longer to decide on a target before sending in a cross - it's helping his aim.
Díaz - Has picked off a few Miami balls.  playing well
Alonso - His job is to keep the back line organized.  He's doing that most of the time, has also moved up the pitch.  The moment he switched off, Miami score
Báez - has been impressive on the left.  making sure that Miami players know he's there and not to be messed with.
Muyumba - has been on fire in the middle, and making things happen up the pitch
Amaro.- doing what he has to do - keeping Miami off the ball in the center
Galoppo - He's planting himself between players, looking to cutoff the pass.  it's working well, but he's not able to see much of the ball as a result
Miranchuk - is making things happen on the right.  Interacting well with Jacob and Amaro.  
Almirón - has not been getting up the pitch as much, preferring to defend.  When he does break, ne looks to be in on goal.  
Embolo - has done well when coming back to get the ball and sends in crosses.  Has been staying out of the striker position a lot.  Looking more fluid.

Player Impressions:
Hoyos - powerless to resist Messi.  Was megged and easily beaten
Jacob - soundly beaten in the 2nd half
Díaz - a nightmare half
Alonso - More involved in the 2nd half.  but still not good enough
Báez - As good as he was in the 1st, he was invisible in the 2nd.  Miami adjusted around him
Muyumba - he was nutralized in the 2nd
Amaro - did ok to stop attacks.  His shots and passes were better aimed this half.  There's only so much he can do alone
Galoppo - had no real effect in the 2nd
Miranchuk - continued working hard all game, trying to make things happen.  couldn't connect on passes, but he had limited options
Embolo - he was better when acting as an attacking midfielder.  Only had 2 shots
Almirón - Not up to par today.  Worked hard, but again cannot do anything in the final 3rd.  He cost Atlanta at least 2 good chances due to bad passing

subs:
Alzate - had no real effect on the game
Sanchez - no real effect on the game
Edwards - was making thing happen on the left.  He is an improvement over Jacob and should be starting
Picault - played better than Miggy.  Had the goal, but it was his hard work leading up to it which resulted in the ball getting into the final 3rd often

Tata - I cannot think of a reason he waited so long to make subs.  The team were out of ideas early in the 2nd half.  It was clear by the 50th that Miami had adjusted and were winning everything.  He made one sub in the 60th, then waited until the 81st.  Far too late for a sub to have any real effect.
